gate:
Some people change the temperature of a room simply by entering it. This code is that change. It is a low, steady pull toward closeness, the drive to find the seam in another person's guard and bring warmth across it. The lineage calls this Sexuality, but the word is too narrow. The reach is wider than the bedroom. It is the force that makes new bonds, new families, new groupings out of what stood apart. Reproduction in the deep sense, before biology gets involved.

Most readings of this drive call it too much. The intensity gets named pushy, hungry, invasive, inappropriate. That misread costs the code its real work, because the work is not seduction. It is the ability to dissolve the small distance that keeps two people from meeting. A person carrying this often does not know they are doing it. The pressure is just there, low in the body, asking to connect.
centre_field:
Low in the belly lives the body's engine, the part of you that runs on life force and gut response. It is the motor for work and for sex, and down there the two are not separate. Same energy aimed at different rooms.

That is the whole teaching of where this drive lives. Closeness here is not a story the head tells itself. It is a yes or a no rising up from underneath before the mind catches up. The engine does not negotiate. It opens, or it closes. To run this code from the head is to feel the pull and the refusal as two contradictory commands, when in fact they are one signal read from the wrong floor. The body is the first reader. Heat rises, or it does not. The information is already there, waiting for the head to stop overruling it.
channel:
On its own, this drive is undirected heat. It can spill toward anyone, scatter itself, mistake any warm body for the right one. The pull to break through closeness needs something to give it edges, or it becomes pressure looking for somewhere to land.

What it reaches for is emotional weather in the other person, the part that runs hot and cold, feels friction, takes time to know whether a bond is actually wanted. The lineage calls this connection mating. The friction half is what teaches the closeness half to wait, to feel the difference between heat and rightness, to sort which warmth is the real one.

Joined, the code becomes the slow work of building families, partnerships, true intimacies that last. Standing alone, it stays intensity without a target. The reach is the whole point. Closeness only becomes bond when it meets the weather that knows which bond was meant.
